property_summary: For any caller and any guess hash, lockInGuess must record the target block as the immediately-next block (block.number+1), so that settling two blocks later (block.number+2) always succeeds; the mutant records block.number+2 and therefore reverts on settle at that block for some inputs.
change_summary: Store the target block as block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1, changing the recorded guess state.
